fields.summary: The district is hiring Everlast Development Inc. of Oakland to cut and haul away dry vegetation, clear weeds, and trim bushes, ivy and low branches along the fence line and around the grounds at Hillcrest Elementary School, to meet the Oakland Fire Code. The $10,600 price includes a $3,000 contingency allowance (a $7,600 base bid), according to the attached contract. Everlast was the lowest responsive bidder in a competitive bid, and work was scheduled to start July 26, 2021, before this approval, and end August 31, 2021.

21-1815.sourceIssue: The text gives $10,600.00 'and a contingency of $3,000.00', which reads as if the contingency is extra; the attached contract and memo say the $10,600.00 includes the $3,000.00 contingency.
